From d74a7566bef76b44416071fbb7e34f301eac8d98 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Matt Roper <matthew.d.roper@intel.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Nov 2019 08:44:12 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915/ehl: Update voltage level checks
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The bspec was recently updated with new cdclk -> voltage level tables to
accommodate the new 324/326.4 cdclk values.

Bspec: 21809
Fixes: 63c9dae71dc5 ("drm/i915/ehl: Add voltage level requirement table")
Cc: José Roberto de Souza <jose.souza@intel.com>
Cc: Vivek Kasireddy <vivek.kasireddy@intel.com>
Cc: Bob Paauwe <bob.j.paauwe@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Matt Roper <matthew.d.roper@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20191118164412.26216-1-matthew.d.roper@intel.com
Reviewed-by: José Roberto de Souza <jose.souza@intel.com>
(cherry picked from commit d147483884ed08ee6bb618ef610ee0329a27fda7)
Signed-off-by: Joonas Lahtinen <joonas.lahtinen@linux.intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_cdclk.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_cdclk.c
index 0caef2592a7e..ed8c7ce62119 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_cdclk.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_cdclk.c
@@ -1273,7 +1273,9 @@ static u8 icl_calc_voltage_level(int cdclk)
 
 static u8 ehl_calc_voltage_level(int cdclk)
 {
-	if (cdclk > 312000)
+	if (cdclk > 326400)
+		return 3;
+	else if (cdclk > 312000)
 		return 2;
 	else if (cdclk > 180000)
 		return 1;
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_cdclk.c`**
   - The function `ehl_calc_voltage_level` was modified to update the voltage level checks based on new specifications.
   - The condition for returning a voltage level of `3` was changed from `if (cdclk > 312000)` to `if (cdclk > 326400)`.
   - An additional condition was added: `else if (cdclk > 312000)` which now returns a voltage level of `2`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The changes in `intel_cdclk.c` are directly related to updates in the bspec (specification document) that introduced new cdclk to voltage level mappings. The modifications ensure that the voltage level calculations align with the latest requirements for the new 324/326.4 cdclk values, thereby fixing potential issues that could arise from outdated voltage level checks. This patch builds upon a previous commit that added the initial voltage level requirement table, indicating a progression in refining the voltage level logic for the EHL (Elkhart Lake) platform.

MIME-Version: 1.0

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by outdated voltage level checks in the `ehl_calc_voltage_level` function, which did not account for the new cdclk values (324/326.4) introduced in the updated bspec. This led to incorrect voltage level assignments for certain cdclk inputs, potentially affecting the performance and stability of the system.

+	if (cdclk > 326400)
+		return 3;
+	else if (cdclk > 312000)
 		return 2;
 	else if (cdclk > 180000)
 		return 1;
 	else
 		return 0;
 }
